next.reason: 1985: OPEN EXTEND of an unavailable optional file creates it as if OPEN OUTPUT, CLOSE, then the OPEN; OPEN OUTPUT creates a file with no data records. 2023: §2023:14.9.27.4 GR17 'the OPEN statement creates the file' by the same OPEN OUTPUT/CLOSE sequence; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR18 'After the creation of the file, the file contains no records'; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 Table 18, EXTEND (optional file) unavailable: 'Open causes the file to be created'. The I-O case is barred for report files in both; the '05' status fills in the status update 1985 GR16 already requires. Same effect.
